autonomous_finite_clock_controller.resource_scope: The moving finite clock packet and both phaseful references are supplied. Reference-gap switching is controlled by the clock position under one static Hamiltonian; its kinetic energy balance is retained.
autonomous_finite_clock_controller.semiboundedness: With L=4096 and recorded g=g_prepare/L, the positive controller kinetic and reference/source energies and disjoint exchange regions give H_total >= -L*max(abs(g),2), equivalently H_total/L >= -max(abs(g),2). An additive constant makes the Hamiltonian positive without changing records.
